channel.title: Duck Dynasty: The Revival
channel.desc: The family honors their patriarch, Phil Robertson, in a way only they can: by dedicating a full day to the things that made him happy, happy, happy. The festivities include a duck-plucking game, a burger-making contest and race in Phil's favorite chair... the recliner. This is a true tribute to the man who built their faith and their family.
